name: fcmulti_v1
doc: Concatenated EN conversations built from existing corpus_v1 / capability_v1 clips (no new TTS): consecutive legitimate tool calls, a long multi-turn session, and user speech arriving while an FC cycle is open (interrupt/abort path). Each part is followed by `gap_s` of silence; `overlay` starts a second clip `at_s` seconds after the end of the first one. i01/i02 overlay relative to the END of the clip (c07 is 30 s incl. trailing silence → lands after the FC: a normal next turn, not an interrupt); i03/i04 use an absolute start inside the measured FC window.

i03.doc: user speech starts inside FC phase 1 (FC open ~9.7-15.4 s on the Ada for c07) → abort/quit path

i04.doc: user speech starts around the tool gap / phase 2
